verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trivy can emit machine-readable SBOM output in CycloneDX and SPDX formats, and community users say it is easy to automate around and integrate into CI/CD pipelines. However, nothing in the pack documents JSON or SARIF output for vulnerability, misconfiguration or secret scan results, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: documented JSON output for scan results, documented SARIF output, evidence that findings (not just SBOMs) can be exported in machine-readable form, independent hands-on confirmation of downstream tooling consumption.
